trigger: I want to join a peaceful protest
description: What to know before and during a peaceful protest.

steps.text: You have the right to assemble peacefully and associate with others (s.40).
You have the right to express your opinions and share information (s.39).
Keep it peaceful - violence and destruction are not protected.
Know the organisers, the route, and have an emergency contact.
If stopped or dispersed, ask on what legal authority, and stay calm.
If arrested, remember your rights and call a lawyer.
